minorityReport.text: Minority report on receiver compatibility assumption (cross-engine interpretation drift). The portable reasoning state (evidence, claims, objections) may be resolved into different objection sets by different agentic architectures or inference engines due to divergent heuristic weights on risk. Even with a matching receiver read-back on one engine, invariance is unproven. This decision is accepted only as conditional structure transfer (trusted:false / unaudited). The objection on assumption asm_receiver_compatible_and_authorized is preserved pending a second receiver on a different inference engine reproducing a matching objection set from the same packet.
